name: Indigo Claude Plugin
description: Claude Code plugin for Indigo home automation development. Provides capabilities as both commands and skills.  It can be used for Indigo plugin development, API integration with either Websocket or HTTP integration with Indigo and for building either control pages or custom HTML pages.
longDescription:
Ships **7 skills**, **7 commands** and **1 hook**.

- **Skills** (7): `api` (This skill should be used when the user asks to "connect to Indigo API", "control Indigo devices remotely",…), `control-pages` (This skill should be used when the user asks to "build a control page", "create an Indigo dashboard",…), `debug-sqllogger` (This skill should be used when the user asks to "debug SQL Logger", "find which devices are causing…), `dev` (This skill should be used when the user asks to "create an Indigo plugin", "build a plugin for…), `guide` (This skill should be used for general Indigo home-automation usage and concept questions that are NOT about writing…), `html-pages` (This skill should be used when the user asks to "build an HTML page for Indigo", "create an…), `update-plugins` (This skill should be used when the user asks to "check for plugin updates", "update Indigo plugins", "bulk…)
- **Commands** (7): `api` (Indigo API integration expert — WebSocket and HTTP APIs for client apps), `control-pages` (Indigo control page builder — guided XML generation with wireframes and export), `debug-sqllogger` (Debug + fix SQL Logger device history errors — surfaces the hidden per-device exception, identifies the failing device,…), `dev` (Indigo plugin development expert — SDK docs, examples, lifecycle, IOM reference), `guide` (Indigo user-guide & concepts expert — devices, interfaces (Z-Wave/Insteon/X10), remote access, bundled plugins), `html-pages` (Indigo HTML page builder — generates interactive dashboard pages with device controls), `update-plugins` (Bulk Indigo plugin updater — finds installed plugins whose versions are out of date, previews the diff, and…)
- **Hooks** (1): `SessionStart`

Installs with `claude plugin install indigo-claude-plugin@claude-community` from `simons-plugins/indigo-claude-plugin`.
